description: Create or continue one conversation per (ticket id, calling service) and post a message into it, or read that service's own conversation, paged: with author_kind person, agent or staff and the author's subject, so a service (Help's agent worker, staff tooling) can answer a ticket without the person send route POST /api/chat/send, which needs a person's session. Loopback only, first-party service token; never granted to an app or delegated to an agent.
